text.original: Set Back Line: A line usually parallel to the plot boundaries or center line of a road and laid down in each case by the Sanctioning Authority or as per recommendations of Master/Zonal Plan, beyond which nothing can be constructed towards the plot boundaries, excepting with the permission of the Sanctioning Authority.
